nodes.label: /admin Content Panel
nodes.rationale: The very first account to sign up at /admin automatically becomes admin, so the creator must sign up before sharing the admin link with the team to control who ends up with admin rights on a fresh deployment.

nodes.label: public.hook_restrict_account_creation (Supabase Auth hook)
nodes.rationale: Restricts self-service admin-panel signups to eligible UPR members (email must end in upr.edu and request IP must fall inside an approved Puerto Rico CIDR range) so open signup cannot be abused, since the first signup automatically becomes admin.

nodes.label: preventFramedRender()
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages cannot set frame-blocking HTTP headers server-side, so this client-side guard attempts to break the page out of an iframe via top-window navigation and, if that navigation is blocked, blanks the frame instead of leaving embedded content visible.
